name: ZCA_ESTIMATION_FEATURES
description: This table is used to capture Import and Export job statistics as test data to compute Estimation Completion Time

columns.name: ZCA_EST_ID
columns.description: This column signifies the id of the record. This is the primary key.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: SEEDED_FLAG
columns.description: represents wether an batch record is seeded or not

columns.name: IMPORT_MODE
columns.description: This column is to store the MODE of IMPORT

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: This column signifies the batch id of that particular record.

columns.name: LANGUAGE_INDEPENDENT_CODE
columns.description: This column signifies the object code of that particular record.

columns.name: NUM_OF_RECORDS
columns.description: This column signifies the number of records of that particular record.

columns.name: IMPORT_TYPE
columns.description: This column signifies the import type of the record. If it is high or low.

columns.name: NUM_OF_ATTRS
columns.description: This column signiifies the number of attributes for that particular record.

columns.name: TOTAL_TIME_TAKEN
columns.description: This column signifies the total time taken for that particular record to be processed.

columns.name: SUCCESS_RECORDS
columns.description: This column signifies the number of success records after the records are processed.

columns.name: ERROR_RECORDS
columns.description: Thsi column signifiies the number of error records after the records are processed.

columns.name: QUEUE_STAY
columns.description: This column signifies the number of records left in the queue.

columns.name: PARALLEL_THREADS
columns.description: This column signifies the number of parallel threads that run for that particular record

columns.name: PARALLEL_BATCHES
columns.description: The column signifies the number of batches running in parallel.

columns.name: CLEANUP_COUNTER
columns.description: This column signifies the cleanup counter for that particular record.

columns.name: COMMIT_SIZE
columns.description: This column signifies the commit size of that particular record to be processed.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: This column signifies the status of the particular record. if the record is to be applied in ml or not

columns.name: ENABLE_ML
columns.description: This column signifies if the particular row can be used for ml processing or not.

columns.name: BATCH_TYPE_CD
columns.description: This column signifies the batch type code of that particular record.

columns.name: POD_SIZE
columns.description: This column signifies the pod size of a given pod.

columns.name: POD_CONFIG
columns.description: This column signifies the configuration of a given pod.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
